schema_characteristics.format: Static individual Agent Card JSON files
schema_characteristics.structure: Uses flat top-level url, protocolVersion (0.3.0), capabilities, and skills array
schema_characteristics.suitability_for_parser_regression: High (provides 103 static, deterministic test vectors for pre-1.0 Agent Card parsing without live network requests)

comparison_with_live_registry.operational_metrics: Static cards do not contain health check timestamps, uptime, or task conformance verification, whereas live registry records include active health monitoring telemetry
